In this paper, we conceptualize the task of automated scholarly taxonomy generation. When given the taxonomy topic and a set of related reference papers, the task for the model is to reason over this large set of reference documents and generate a taxonomy tree that is both concise and provides maximal coverage of the reference documents.
datasets: Additional test set (80 taxonomies from conference surveys)
outputs: hierarchical taxonomy trees (nodes and edges representing topics and sub‑topics)
